Hi Ming & Priya,

Thanks again for scheduling the product walkthrough. I’ve put a demo on the calendar and sent the invite from my account:

  - Proposed slot: Thu Jul 22, 2027 — 09:30 AM PDT (organizer time) / Fri Jul 23, 2027 — 01:30 AM AEST

I realize that’s an awkward timezone overlap for you in APAC; happy to move to a more convenient spot. I’m attaching the initial proposal PDF and the calendar invite I created. Please tell me if the event appears at the correct local time on your side.

If the Google invite looks off, a quick workaround is to open the event in Calendar and check the timezone shown under "Event details" (sometimes a forwarded .ics loses its timezone anchor and shows as a floating time). If you see anything inconsistent, say the word and I’ll generate an explicit UTC-anchored .ics.

Next steps: can you confirm whether 9:30 AM PDT still works or propose two alternate windows (your local times please) and I’ll resend a corrected invite?

Subject: Re: APAC demo — calendar shows wrong zone, need corrected ICS

Jordan —

Thanks for the invite. Quick note: when I opened the Google Calendar event the time shows as 1:30 AM on Jul 23 in my calendar (which is what I expected), but when I forward the invite internally it sometimes flips to 9:30 AM (the organizer time) and then other attendees see the event on the wrong day. Priya and I tried adding it to our shared team calendar and it floated to a different date entirely.

We suspect the .ics you sent might be missing an explicit TZID or it was forwarded through an email client that stripped timezone metadata. Could you please:

  1) Send a version of the invite anchored to UTC (e.g., 16:30 UTC) so clients in APAC/EU/US resolve consistently, or
  2) Send two alternate local-friendly slots (our office hours are 9:00–17:00 SGT) so we can pick one without timezone gymnastics.

Also, can you confirm the event timezone shown when you open the event details? Screenshots are helpful if easier.

Appreciate it — we’re excited to see the demo.

Best,
Ming Zhao
Head of Platform Integrations
NovaSys Analytics
ming.zhao@novasys.com

Hi Ming & Priya,

Sorry for the calendar noise — I generated a corrected invite that should be fully timezone-anchored. Notes:

  - The DTSTART/DTEND entries use UTC with trailing Z (e.g., DTSTART:20270722T163000Z) and a full VTIMEZONE block is included, which prevents clients from treating the event as "floating."
  - I tested importing the .ics into Google Calendar and Outlook; both show the correct local times for PDT/AEST/SGT.

I attached: corrected-demo-invite.ics (UTC-anchored) — requesting you add that version to your calendars and delete any earlier forwarded copies.

Confirmed slot in UTC: 2027-07-22T16:30:00Z (this corresponds to Thu Jul 22, 09:30 PDT / Fri Jul 23, 01:30 AEST).

If you’d prefer a different local time, Jordan will re-open the scheduling. Otherwise I’ll treat this as final after you accept the attached invite.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
